about.heading: Hi, I'm Bethel.
intro: I’m a multimedia professional who brings together creative storytelling, production technology, and a commitment to helping people learn and grow.

My experience spans directing media teams, producing digital content, supporting professional AV environments, and building interactive educational workshops. The common thread is creating meaningful experiences for people on both sides of the camera.

blocks.title: Educational media
blocks.text: At Roxbury Tenants of Harvard, I developed lessons, presentations, infographics and interactive workshops, helping young people learn and explore a community garden.

blocks.title: Production leadership
blocks.text: At Pentecostal Tabernacle, I led livestream and creative production, team coordination, volunteer onboarding, camera training, and cross-department projects.

blocks.title: AV & creative technology
blocks.text: Work with Red Thread, Encore Global, and Proper Bantah has brought together technical troubleshooting, live events, and digital storytelling.

blocks.title: Brandeis University
blocks.text: Bachelor of Arts, Health: Science, Society, and Policy · 2020.

blocks.title: Team development
blocks.text: Mentorship, coaching, instructional design, volunteer training, and making creative technology accessible.

blocks.title: Creative focus
blocks.text: Visual storytelling, media production leadership, documentary and fiction development, and education through media.

resume.heading: Experience, education & production.
resume.description: Multimedia production leadership, creative direction, audiovisual technology, and helping people learn through media.

entries.title: Interim Director of Media & Production Lead
highlights: Managed production for services, conferences, and special events while aligning volunteers, worship, welcome, and creative teams.
Coordinated production schedules, recruited and trained volunteers, maintained media workflows, and prepared weekly ProPresenter playlists.
Collaborated on equipment purchasing and maintenance, booked external creative talent, proposed original content, and supported filming and editing.

entries.title: Onsite AV Technician
highlights: Support hybrid meetings across Webex, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet; operate and troubleshoot room AV systems.
Respond to help-desk tickets, document support procedures, provide daily user assistance, and conduct preventive maintenance.
Maintain room and equipment inventories and support local and remote meetings and events.

entries.title: Event Technical Supervisor & AV Technical Lead
highlights: Supervised on-site event technical crews and operations across audio, video, staging, and equipment.
Provided hands-on technician training, coordinated freelancers and venue requirements, and resolved urgent AV issues.
Managed equipment inventory and supported administrative processes for live-event delivery.

entries.title: Media Lead
highlights: Led camera crews and collaborated with photographers and videographers for recorded and live-streamed services.
Operated cameras, coordinated video capture, supported equipment setup and breakdown, and mixed live audio for services and streams.

entries.title: Health Education & Wellness Intern
highlights: Designed and led educational workshops for high school students on health, careers, nutrition, media literacy, and self-care.
Created infographics and presentations and supported students' work in a community garden.

entries.title: Human Resources Coordinator
highlights: Worked with subject-matter experts to develop interactive healthcare compliance training.
Created storyboards, scripts, narration, videos, graphics, animation, and simulations for instructional content.

entries.title: Student Support Specialist
entries.employer: Brandeis University — Sound and Image Media Studios
highlights: Trained students and community members in video, audio, photography, graphic design, and animation.
Provided walk-in technical troubleshooting and in-depth one-on-one consultations to support creative projects.

entries.title: Technical Director
highlights: Produced digital storytelling content highlighting underrepresented communities, including video, infographics, animations, and promotional media.
Directed studio camera work, managed equipment and sound setup, and produced music and video promotions for two seasons.

entries.title: Music Composer & Producer
highlights: Composed and arranged music for advertisements, podcasts, documentaries, and short films.
Managed recording, editing, mixing, and mastering using digital audio workstations.

entries.title: Location Assistant
highlights: Supported on-set logistics, background performer holding areas, and shoot-day preparation and wrap for a television production.

entries.title: Phlebotomist
highlights: Collected plasma specimens according to established procedures and monitored donors for equipment issues or reactions.

entries.title: Audio Editor
highlights: Edited and quality-checked podcast audio, diagnosed recording issues, and delivered completed episodes on short timelines.

entries.title: Sound Engineer
highlights: Mixed live audio for services and livestreams, operated cameras, and helped distribute sermon recordings.

entries.title: President
highlights: Led the student record label's executive board and organized events to help members develop music-production and promotional skills.

entries.title: Intern
highlights: Observed clinical rounds and helped verify demographic data in patient records.

entries.title: Volunteer Worker
highlights: Participated in volunteer activities and created visual presentations supporting other members.
